name: fanzero
description: Publish games with FanZero and connect with content creators through launch visibility and revenue-share pacts.

interface.longDescription: Prepare a complete game listing with images or videos, platform-specific prices and monetization, then submit it to FanZero in one operation with approved studio details and revenue-share offers. A playable upload is optional; native and online games can remain on their existing platforms. Human curator review is required. Includes a publishing skill; manual MCP connections are configured separately.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my game can be published on FanZero.
Prepare a FanZero listing and revenue-share offer for my approval.
Review my FanZero creator proposals and their revenue-share dates.

publication.release_notes: Support complete game listings, optional playable uploads and idempotent one-operation publishing.
